jobs.title: WEBINAR: How to migrate paratransit software without disrupting service.
jobs.description: Webinar How to migrate paratransit software without disrupting service. September 17 | 1pm EST | Zoom New software can promise the world, but if drivers and dispatchers don't trust it, adoption stalls before it starts. The agencies that get this right treat rollout as a people problem first and a technology problem second—and it shows up in faster adoption, smoother operations, and better results. In this session, we'll explore how agencies build internal trust from day one, and what that means for dispatch, scheduling, and day-to-day service delivery. Sign up for the webinar. What you'll learn. Take a look at what we'll cover in this power-packed live discussion: How to earn operator trust and drive real adoption when rolling out new technology. How to equip dispatch and scheduling teams with practical strategies that smooth out daily operations. How to turn internal buy-in into lasting service improvements, not just a successful launch. Questions? We're here to help! Reach out to Lucile Perrot at lucile.perrot@ridewithvia.com and she'll get back to you shortly. jobs.title: Interview at Via
jobs.description: Interviewing at Via. At Via, we’re committed to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve, and we’re all about making every journey as smooth as possible. The hiring process is no exception — we customize the journey according to each role, to ensure that you get the clearest picture of what life at Via could be like. We put this handy guide together to make sure you feel supported along the way. Your Via hiring journey. We’re so excited to get to know each other better, which is why your Via hiring journey includes a few essential pit stops to ensure a mutual match. You’ll discover our vision for the future of mobility, and start to gel with Via’s best and brightest — at least six team members from different parts of the business with a mix of in-person and virtual interviews. You'll be able to take a peek at how you could fit in at Via for a win-win career. First impressions. We like to kick things off with a call between you and one of our team members, who will give you an overview of the role and lay out next steps in the process. This is your time to show us who you are, what you’ve been working on, and why you’re excited about the opportunity that lies ahead. Feel free to ask us any questions you have! Deeper dive. We believe that innovative solutions are born from close collaboration between passionate, friendly, and humble people. It’s no surprise, then, that this next step is typically a video interview with the hiring manager of the role. You’ll share more details about the projects you’ve tackled, what you’ve learned, and how you expect to use those skills in the future. Stand out. This is where it gets really fun. Here, you’ll chat with 3-5 team members over a series of longer interviews about Via’s growth, ambitious future and, most importantly, how this shared ride could be the right call for you. We also want to see your growing enthusiasm for Via and the role. Where you’ve been. If we think you’re a great fit for the role, we want to make sure your past teammates and managers agree. This stop’s focus is all about your relationship with your references, so we’ll reach out to the people who know you best and hear all of the great things they have to say about you. We will ask for two professional references — ideally two former direct supervisors. The last stop! Now that we both have a better understanding of each other, our hiring team will discuss your candidacy and the road ahead. If it’s a mutual YES, you can expect an offer to join the ride. Then we all celebrate. Interview prep. We know it can be daunting to feel like you need to become a company expert before an interview. Consider these links a solid starting point to understanding who we are and what we do: Our Product The Via Offering Via in Action (Tools) Our Culture Life at Via Teams Our Impact Our Partners and their Stories Via in the News About Via. We are the world’s most powerful digital infrastructure for public transportation. Via’s software provides an end-to-end solution to plan, optimize, and operate efficient and equitable transit systems — unlocking opportunity for all, and building resilient cities for the future. Via is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. See also EEO is the Law, Supplement to EEO is the Law, and Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Via is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please email us at jobs@ridewithvia.com for further assistance. ‍ Please note that Via only uses company email addresses, which contain “@ridewithvia.com”, to communicate with candidates via email. Via uses secure tools to receive applicant data and would not ask applicants to submit sensitive personal information to apply for a job. If you are contacted by someone about a job at Via, please verify the domain of the sender’s email address. If you believe you’ve been a victim of a phishing scam, please visit the Department of Justice’s Cyber Crime website to report it. jobs.title: Customer Service Representative (German-speaking)
jobs.description: Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally. As a Customer Service Representative at Via, you will be the human connection between our technology and the people who depend on it -helping hundreds of thousands of riders and drivers across hundreds of cities every day. You'll keep our on-demand services running smoothly, sitting at the heart of our Operations team and gaining hands-on experience across operations, technology management, and on-demand mobility in a fast-moving, mission-driven environment. If you care about making public transit work better for real people - see the impact we're having in the around the world - this team is where that commitment comes to life every day. This job can be done remotely, as long as you are based in Germany. What You’ll Do: Ensure the smooth daily operation of our services by providing telephone, live chat, and email support. Work scheduled shifts, with appropriate shift bonuses for night shifts, Sundays, or pre-determined holidays. Make sure that our drivers and passengers feel supported in all matters, always helping them with their questions or concerns. Care for customer satisfaction and ensure that issues are resolved. Grow with your tasks and responsibilities if you so choose, and increase your compensation accordingly. Who You Are: Passionate about Via's mission to enable access to mobility and reduce the world's carbon footprint - you see this as more than a job. Fluent in German and English (C1 or C2) -you'll be using both languages daily as you'll be working across both our DACH and UK markets. A strong communicator who finds the right tone in any context and genuinely enjoys supporting people over the phone. Calm under pressure and able to think on your feet — no prior call center experience required; what matters is a willingness to learn and a commitment to great service. Technology-savvy and comfortable working with modern IT tools. Flexible and adaptable across different shifts; while we try to accommodate individual schedules, this role requires some availability outside standard hours to support our 24/7 operations. What We Offer 100% work from home, as long as you're based in Germany. State-of-the-art hardware provided so you can work worry-free. €15.40/h base pay for a 40-hour work week, with additional earnings depending on shifts and hours worked. 30 days of vacation inclusive of public holidays. The opportunity to work for a company with a strong mission of improving the quality of life for those who need it most. There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride? Via is an equal opportunity employer. #LI-RB1
